entries.name: Deborah Stout

expected.charges: Civil contempt for refusing grand-jury testimony after immunity
expected.sentence: Jailed February 18, 1994; continued confinement was reported in June. Her contempt order was affirmed March 28. The reviewed sources do not establish her release date.

updates.sentence: Civil contempt confinement beginning February 18, 1994; released July 18, 1994. Stout personally reported her release after five months in Spokane County Jail in Earth First!, Lughnasadh 1994, printed page 8. Her release did not end Kimberly Trimiew’s separate confinement.

entries.rationale: First-person account identifies Monday July 18 release after exactly five months; original page rendered and visually verified. Existing February 18 admission preserved. This completes a 150-day interval.

entries.name: Jennifer Prichard

expected.charges: Cove–Mallard road-blockade conviction — individual count unverified
expected.sentence: The coalition report states that she served the initial thirty-one days of a ninety-day sentence during summer and fall 1993. Individual custody intervals within that year are not resolved. This is the earlier portion, not an additional ninety-day term.

entries.rationale: Idaho Supreme Court opinion individually identifies June 30, 1993 arrest while chained to the access gate. Add only to original blockade case; preserve separate 1994 probation custody and unresolved 1993 interval boundaries.

entries.name: Peggy Sue McRae

expected.charges: Refusal to pay court-ordered restitution following Cove–Mallard road-blockade case
expected.sentence: Committed July 7, 1994 for sixty-one days after refusing restitution. The coalition published her statement from Idaho County Jail in August. The exact underlying plea count, any earlier custody episode and the release date remain unverified.

updates.sentence: Committed July 7, 1994 for sixty-one days after refusing restitution. The coalition published her statement from Idaho County Jail in August. The exact underlying plea count, any earlier custody episode and the release date remain unverified. The underlying road-blockade arrest occurred July 15, 1993, as individually identified in Highland Enterprises v. Barker. This arrest date does not indicate continuous imprisonment from 1993 to the separate July 1994 return to custody.

entries.rationale: Court identifies underlying July 15, 1993 blockade arrest. Keep July 7, 1994 admission for restitution-related custody; no continuous span or release inferred.
